title: AssignmentPoll
description: Long-poll request from a warm runtime for its next assignment, assignment-poll/1 (decision D33). The runtime has no inbound port, so it asks; identity comes from workload authentication, not this body.

mode.description: Mode this runtime serves; when present, only deployments of that mode are offered (absent: any).

imageDigest.description: Runtime image digest; when present, only deployments pinned to this image are offered (absent: any).
